title: spectra
description: Long-format spectra: one row per unit x time x sensor x wavelength.

time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (state the timezone assumption in the card if none is given).

wavelength_nm.description: Band centre wavelength in nanometres (parsed from metadata or column names).

aggregation.description: How pixels were summarised (median over mask, mean, ...).

source_table.description: Raw table (relative to the bundle root) the row came from.

source_row_key.description: Key of the raw row, for tracing back.
